preconditions.description: The number of test cases t must be between 1 and 10,000.
The number of elements n in each test case must be between 1 and 10,000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= a_i <= 10**5 for a_i in a)
preconditions.description: Each element a_i in the array must be a positive integer between 1 and 100,000.
The total number of elements across all test cases must not exceed 10,000.

postconditions.expression: stdout == '-1' if not can_equalize(a) else True
postconditions.description: If it is impossible to equalize the array, output -1.
The number of operations k must not exceed 3n.

postconditions.expression: all(a_i == a[0] for a_i in a)
postconditions.description: After the operations, all elements of the array must be equal.
